symptom: macOS: start-failed, ciadpi rc=255 'bind: Address already in use' even after quitting Chrome and reinstalling.
cause: reap_orphans() only pkills ciadpi at OUR install path. Port 1080 was held by a process it never matches (a ciadpi from another path, or an unrelated proxy). ciadpi is detached (start_new_session), so quitting Chrome never frees the port.
fix: free_port(): lsof the listener on the port before launch; kill any ciadpi regardless of path, otherwise return an error naming the process and pid.

symptom: nh-001 on macOS: lsof showed port 1080 held by 'Code Helper' (VS Code), not ciadpi.
cause: VS Code Remote-SSH auto-forwarded remote port 1080 (a ciadpi run on the remote Linux dev box) to the Mac's 127.0.0.1:1080 and kept the forward bound.
fix: Stop the forward in VS Code's Ports panel or set remote.autoForwardPorts=false; the host now names the owner and adds a VS Code hint.
